newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won ends firmer in line with yen strength.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won ends firmer in line with yen strength.

text.p: The won closed firmer against the dollar on Thursday in line with the Japanese yen's rise in overseas markets, dealers said.
The yen's strength touched off stop-loss sales of the U.S. unit, they said. The won ended at 889.10 against Wednesday's close of 892.00 after hitting a day high of 888.80.

Dealers said the won was unlikely to rise much further on Friday as importer settlement deals were expected to increase as a new month begins. The won's base mid-rate was forecast to be set at 890.80 on Friday, compared with Thursday's 892.00.
